_what: House rules for the table you actually play at. Everything in the engine and the playbook should read from here, never from constants.
_self_draw_note: A Self-Draw (zi mo) may win with 1 Fan. A win on an opponent's discard still needs 2. This is a house rule NOT in the analytic source - every Minimum-Fan-2 table below assumes 2 Fan for every win, so treat them as slightly pessimistic for hands sitting at exactly 1 Fan.
_payout_note: Source states its immediate-payout values assume Minimum Fan 1 and DOUBLE at Minimum Fan 2. So on this table: Kong-1/Kong-3 = 4, Kong-4 = 8, Animal or Flower set = 8, Animal or Flower pair = 4, all doubled again if obtained from the initial 13 tiles.

unconfirmed.pay_all_fresh_tile_threshold: 3 to 8 remaining; confirm the number and whether 'fresh' counts exposed tiles or discards only
unconfirmed.self_draw_bonus_fan: some tables add +1 Fan for a Self-Draw - confirm whether yours does on top of the 1-Fan exemption
unconfirmed.seven_pairs: some tables allow a Hong Kong style seven-pairs hand - confirm
